question.text: Three forces start acting simultaneously on a particle moving with velocity, $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{v}}$. These forces are represented in magnitude and direction by the three sides of a triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$. The particle will now move with velocity

options.text: $|\mathrm{v}|$ in the direction of the largest force $\mathrm{BC}$

solution.text:
According to triangle law of forces, the resultant force is zero.
In presence of zero external force, there is no change in velocity
